C:P1.1.text: WEX | Simplify business fuel cards, employee benefits, & payment solutions

C:P1.2.text: WEX is the global commerce platform for fuel and fleet, employee benefits, and business payments. Simplify your business and let WEX handle the complex.

C:P1.3.text: The smart fuel card for serious savings

C:P1.4.text: The WEX Fleet Card gives you better security, simplified fuel tracking, and helps prevent unauthorized spending. Apply today and save up to 15¢ per gallon through our nationwide savings network.*

C:P1.5.text: Accepted at 95% of U.S. fueling stations

C:P1.6.text: Get serviced at multiple locations nationwide

C:P1.7.text: Join 20M business vehicles that already fuel with WEX

C:P1.8.text: WEX Benefits brings benefits accounts, administration, compliance, and COBRA together — turning disjointed systems into one total solution built for your business to thrive.

C:P1.9.text: Mastering the complex: One unified workflow for accounts, compliance, and admin

C:P1.10.text: Trusted to deliver: Built on 40 years of market-leading operational strength

C:P1.11.text: Powering what’s next: AI guidance and real-time payments for your people

C:P1.13.text: Select the product that best fits your needs

C:P1.14.text: Save money, speed up processing, build supplier loyalty, help reduce fraud and drive new revenue streams with payment solutions designed for your business.

C:P1.16.text: Reduce fuel costs, support your drivers, transition to a mixed or electric fleet, and improve vehicle operations with technology and analytics to reduce spending for any business, any fleet, and any number of vehicles.

C:P1.17.text: Attract new talent, retain employees, increase participation, and save money with our end-to-end benefits administration, including HSAs, FSAs, and more.

C:P1.18.text: Find the login that’s right for you or explore all that WEX has to offer.

C:P1.19.text: Fleet management software: Emerging technologies are changing the game

C:P1.20.text: Learn the trends in fleet management software and how the technology is changing commercial vehicle fleet operations. EMIT, an emissions analysis tool, is one example of technological advancement. Discover new ways to build efficiencies and gain further ground for your business.

C:P1.21.text: Let WEX help you unlock your company’s full potential with solutions to remove day-to-day obstacles.
